key_findings: Exogenous LacZ in Kcna6 gene-trap mice is neurotoxic to central nociceptor terminals, confounding phenotypes.
In LacZ-free Kcna6 KO mice, Kv1.6 regulates acute noxious heat sensitivity and nerve-injury hypersensitivity.
